description: This file defines the DirectOutput class within the WPEFramework::Messaging namespace, which manages direct output for messaging, including configuration for syslog mode and message abbreviation. It includes methods for setting modes and outputting messages, and references external modules and messaging components.

classes.name: DirectOutput
classes.description: A class that manages direct output for messaging, allowing configuration of syslog mode and message abbreviation, and providing an output method for message info and events.

methods.name: DirectOutput
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DirectOutput object with the current time, default syslog mode (false), and full message abbreviation.

methods.name: Mode
methods.description: Sets the output mode, configuring whether syslog is used and the message abbreviation level.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs a message based on the provided message info and event, implementation details not provided in the header.
